notes.title: Patch 1.01 Live
notes.notes:
Greetings! Some minor fixes and a game breaking issue has been solved. Thank you for your feedbacks!

PATCH NOTES 1.01

FIXED: crash on event 040 where an incorrect dialog box was set to the three hanging men
FIXED: event 048 - a narrator line was displayed with an incorrect dialog box
FIXED: Eustachio's description was not updating correctly after event 26
FIXED: One branch in Astrea's event was not applying the correct effects on resources
FIXED: Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Launch Update! Patch 1.0
notes.notes:
Greetings!
We have been busy at work for a while developing this update and we were able to improve the game only thanks to the feedback you gave us here on Steam and on our channels on social media. This update contains a huge list of improvements and features and we are going to support the game as much as possible. Unfortunately, EA didn't help with sales as expected so new languages have been put on hold. Content has always been 100% in since the EA launch and we didn't change launch price as promised. When we set the 75% discount for the Summer Sale, we didn't expect to go on with the full release but things changed during the last week [biz event for devs running in our country] so we decided to speed-up things to secure reviews with outlets going out on Meta: buzz is the key and we hope that visibility could help to spread the word

notes.title: Midnight Caravan leaves Early Access today!
notes.notes:
Gamera Interactive is happy to announce that its new game, Midnight Caravan, is finally going to be released today, leaving Early Access. Midnight Caravan is a richly illustrated choose-your-own adventure with a unique narrative arc propelling the player in an age renowned for its shadiness, where nothing is how it appears to be: no clear distinction between good and evil exist, nor between friends or foes!

Gamblers, prostitutes, murderers, thieves, though moral choices and crimes set the tone for this western visual novel set in a gothic 19th century in Italy. Set at the very beginning of the Risorgimento, the game tells the story of a caravan of outcasts led by the protagonist that will be involved in a dangerous travel across the country: from Rome to Venice, passing through Florence. A gripping story of vengeance, politic, intrigues, espionage and violence awaits you as the leader of the Midnight Caravan. 

A massive number of fixes come with the full release, in the latest huge update just gone live and the studio is very proud of the result, thanks to the feedback we've got in these months.

We really hope players will enjoy the unique story we've created, digging in our historical background to shape this visual novel, actually the one and only merging two worlds (Western and Eastern), twisting the genre with a few amazing features we are proud of, such as RPG elements, inventory management and different endings!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Midnight Caravan enters Early Access on August 24!
notes.notes:
Gamera Interactive is happy to announce that its new game, Midnight Caravan, will soon be available on Steam Early Access: launch date is scheduled for August 24th!

Midnight Caravanan is a richly illustrated choose-your-own adventure with a unique narrative arc propelling the player in an age renowned for its shadiness, where nothing is how it appears to be: no clear distinction between good and evil exist, nor between friends or foes!

Gamblers, prostitutes, murderers, thieves, though moral choices and crimes set the tone for this western visual novel set in a gothic 19th century in Italy. Set at the very beginning of the Risorgimento, the game tells the story of a caravan of outcasts led by the protagonist that will be involved in a dangerous travel across the country: from Rome to Venice, passing through Florence. A gripping story of vengeance, politic, intrigues, espionage and violence awaits you as the leader of the Midnight Caravan. Will you protect your people, or will you pursue your own fortune? 

The Early Access version of the game contains the full playable game and the full release is planned for March 2021 the latest, with new contents and localization support following feedbacks of the community. Midnight Caravan will be available with a 15% discount on August 24th

For more info just check Gamera Interactive website at [url=store.steampowered.com] http://www,gamerainteractive.it [/url]
